title: Melissa NDE 22910
content: I was sitting in the dirt watching my dad make a horse for me out of wood. I was so excited at the thought that I was going to have a pony that I squeezed my dog with a tight hug and it turned to bite me in the face. my first memory of the OBE was my seeing my father lifting me over the fence to hand me to the neighbor on the other side telling my mom to get the dog away. I heard screams and saw my mom dragging the dog to the back yard and my sister and brother calling the police I remember telling them without speaking to be calm. It was my sister who was actually talking on the phone. My dad jumped the fence and was holding my hand and the ambulance came down the street. I remember seeing myself convulsing and then nothing until after at the hospital where I remember seeing a bunch of men trying to strap me down and they gave me a shot then the men walked out of the room and I dont remember a thing until I was basically waking from a dream so it felt.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Life threatening event, but not clinical death. I was bit in the face above and in the corner of my eye by a German Shepherd when I was 3 years old.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes There was no appearance I just was
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning my sense of time was that it didn't matter
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I heard a voice telling me that everything is ok
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain It was bright and cloudy kind of like I was in a room with a see thru floor
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes It was very bright all around like a bright cloud. I was also lite up like a bright ora around me
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I didn't smell or touch anything I just heard saw and felt emotion
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I knew it was alright I had no fear or worry
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I saw the event like a movie and I was the one who had been bit
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was aware it was time to go back I could hear the doctors and my mothers voice as she said shes waking up
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was aware it was time to go back I could hear the doctors and my mothers voice as she said shes waking up God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I didn't fear death. I believe in a higher power. I have faith
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I didn't fear death. I believe in a higher power. I have faith After the NDE
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes after that I saw two shadow figures at the foot of my bed whispering about how cute I was
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: It was peaceful and I was sad that it was my fault my dog got put to sleep
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes they shared their experiences and knowledge of things that are so called taboo
